description: This file defines a Kotlin interface named TopicsRepository for managing topic data within a project. It includes methods for retrieving a stream of topics and specific topic data, extending a Syncable interface.

classes.name: TopicsRepository
classes.description: An interface for topic data repository with methods to get all topics and individual topics.

methods.name: getTopics
methods.description: Returns a flow stream of the list of available topics.

methods.name: getTopic
methods.description: Returns a flow stream of data for a specific topic given its ID.
